title: Works on your laptop, breaks on the server? Watch this
caption: Containers in plain English. Docker or Podman: which do you use?

scenes.vo: Your app works on your laptop, but breaks on the server. Sound familiar? Containers fix exactly that.
scenes.heading: CONTAINERS

scenes.vo: Think of a shipping container. Whatever is inside, every ship, truck and crane handles it the same way.
scenes.heading: THINK OF IT LIKE

scenes.vo: A container packs your code, libraries and settings into one image, and shares the host's kernel, so it starts in seconds.
scenes.heading: INSIDE A CONTAINER

scenes.vo: One server can run many containers side by side. If one crashes, the others keep running untouched.
scenes.heading: ISOLATED

scenes.vo: Try it now. One command downloads nginx and runs it in a container, ready in seconds.
scenes.heading: TRY IT

scenes.vo: Containers: portable, lightweight, and isolated. And Kubernetes is how you run thousands of them. Follow for more.
scenes.heading: CONTAINERS
